reject_reason: After act relocates to a different store: frame 4's background is a retail shoe-shop wall with stacked shoe boxes and a storefront window, not the laundry counter the before/middle acts (and the approved after STILL) show - the after CLIP's gentle pull-back invented new surroundings again, third case of this failure mode today (wallet v2 window-scene, kids-shoe shoe-store). Secondary: cu1 crop spends the first close-up on the craftsman's forearm with the shoe barely in frame, and frames 2-3 carry a posterized, outline-heavy render quality that reads as AI. Object identity itself holds (three straps, shell toe, perforations consistent; grey scuff landmark worked by the brush in frame 3). Fix path: regenerate ONLY the after clip after changing the after-act camera direction from pull-back to a settle/hold that forbids revealing area beyond the supplied frame; before/middle clips are keepers.
